title: Russian Spring Vegetable Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with fresh spring vegetables and a touch of zesty goodness. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped spring onions and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add sliced carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add diced potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add sliced zucchini and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add Russian Vegetable Stew Mix and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
